title: PARP inhibitor combination therapy in BRCA-mutated ovarian cancer: a phase II review
snippet: Combination of a PARP inhibitor with low-dose chemotherapy improved progression-free survival by 4.2 months in BRCA1/2-mutated ovarian cancer cohorts compared to monotherapy.

title: Tumor microenvironment remodeling as a resistance mechanism to checkpoint inhibitors
snippet: Fibroblast-driven remodeling of the tumor microenvironment was associated with reduced T-cell infiltration and acquired resistance to PD-1 checkpoint inhibitors in carcinoma models.

title: SGLT2 inhibitors and cardiovascular outcomes in patients with resistant hypertension
snippet: SGLT2 inhibitor add-on therapy reduced systolic blood pressure by an average of 6 mmHg and lowered heart-failure hospitalization risk in patients with resistant hypertension.

title: Atrial fibrillation ablation outcomes in patients with concurrent heart failure
snippet: Catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation showed durable sinus rhythm maintenance at 12 months in a majority of patients with concurrent heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.

title: Metformin extended-release formulation and glycemic control in type 2 diabetes
snippet: Extended-release metformin achieved comparable glycemic control to immediate-release formulations with a significant reduction in gastrointestinal adverse events.

title: GLP-1 receptor agonists as adjunct therapy in insulin-resistant type 2 diabetes
snippet: GLP-1 receptor agonist add-on therapy improved insulin sensitivity markers and produced modest weight loss over a 26-week treatment period in insulin-resistant patients.

title: Anti-amyloid monoclonal antibody therapy and cognitive decline in early Alzheimer's disease
snippet: Anti-amyloid monoclonal antibody treatment slowed the rate of cognitive decline on standard composite scores over 18 months in early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease.

title: Broad-spectrum antiviral candidate efficacy against emerging respiratory pathogens
snippet: A broad-spectrum antiviral candidate reduced viral load by two orders of magnitude in vitro against several emerging respiratory pathogens, with favorable early safety signals.
